dominant_strengths: Confident hero typography with clear weight hierarchy and well-tuned green accent that ties to the Supabase brand mark.
Disciplined dark palette with restrained chrome — nav, CTAs and logo wall coexist without visual noise.
Solid information architecture: tagline, supporting paragraph, dual CTA, and trust row read in a clean vertical rhythm.
dominant_weaknesses: Layout is a generic dev-tool hero template — center-stacked headline plus logo wall offers little distinctiveness vs peers.
Logo wall is poorly cropped on the left ('shares' bleeding in) and logos vary in optical weight, hurting craft.
Reflective payoff is thin: no product visualization, schema, or code artifact to anchor the 'Postgres platform' promise.
fix_priorities: Add a product surface (dashboard, SQL, or schema visual) below the fold-line to make the platform tangible.
Fix logo wall cropping, normalize logo heights, and consider a marquee or grid with consistent optical sizing.
Differentiate the hero with a signature visual motif (gradient mesh, terminal, or live data) instead of pure text-on-black.
Tighten secondary CTA contrast — 'Request a demo' nearly disappears against the black background.
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity leads, visceral impact is competent but template-like, and reflective depth is underdeveloped without product proof.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it reads unmistakably as a modern devtools landing page, but it leans on category conventions rather than asserting Supabase's specific identity.
